name: LTY's Transit Expansion Decoration
description: LTY's Transit Expansion Decoration（LTED）是 Minecraft Transit Railway 的装饰拓展：厦门风格的屏蔽门与站台方块、地铁与 BRT 两种 PIDS、PSD-LCD 吊板、挂墙与挂顶发车倒数器、站外标志与贴墙标识、时钟、售票机 / 闸机 / 安检机 / 充电宝 / 饮料机、RCC 站台方块、厦门与南普陀与角美的装饰物件，以及方速屏蔽门的搬运版。 LTY's Transit Expansion Decoration (LTED) is a decoration add-on for Minecraft Transit Railway: Xiamen-style platform screen doors and platform blocks, two PIDS variants (metro and BRT), PSD-LCD hanging boards, wall and ceiling departure countdowns, station signage, clocks, ticket machines, gates, security scanners, power-bank and drinks machines, RCC platform blocks, Xiamen, Nanputuo and Jiaomei decoration props, and a ported Fangsu platform screen door set.
authors: 厦航在拍车的无名机长 (kigurumiLTY)
